- [EVENT] User is looking for advice on how to properly wash their Nike Dri-FIT running socks to get rid of the smell.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended checking the care label of the socks for specific washing instructions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested turning the socks inside out before washing to protect the outer fabric.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised washing the socks in cold water (below 30°C or 86°F) to prevent shrinkage and color fading.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using a mild detergent designed for activewear and avoiding harsh detergents, bleach, or fabric softener.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested hand washing or using a gentle wash cycle with a mesh laundry bag to protect the socks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised against over-washing the socks to maintain their shape and performance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended adding 1/2 cup of white vinegar to the wash cycle or soaking the socks in a vinegar solution (1 part vinegar to 2 parts water) for about an hour before washing to remove odor-causing bacteria.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a sports detergent with odor-fighting properties.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended air drying the socks or tumble drying on low heat to prevent shrinkage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised against wringing or twisting the socks to remove excess water.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested washing the socks every 3-5 wearings to prevent odor buildup.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended storing socks in a well-ventilated area or in a mesh bag when not in use.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considering using an odor-controlling spray, such as baking soda-based sprays or specialized sprays.
